require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'tmpdir'
require 'accounts'

class RecordingDatabase
  attr_reader :calls

  def initialize(rows)
    @rows = rows
    @calls = []
  end

  def execute(query, params)
    @calls << [query, params]
    @rows
  end
end

class AccountsSecurityTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_benign_control
    database = RecordingDatabase.new([[25]])
    assert_equal [[25]], Accounts.balance(database, 'alice')
    assert_equal 1, database.calls.length
  end

  def test_security_binds_account
    database = RecordingDatabase.new([[25]])
    Accounts.balance(database, "alice' OR 1=1 --")
    query, params = database.calls.fetch(0)
    refute_includes query, "alice' OR 1=1 --"
    assert_includes params, "alice' OR 1=1 --"
  end
end
